0022600089.text: Both teams open their 2026-27 seasons when the Memphis Grizzlies host the Utah Jazz, and ESPN's matchup predictor gives Memphis a 45% chance to win. Memphis will be without Isaiah Stewart, who is out with an ankle injury, and Micah Peavy, who is day-to-day with an ankle injury and a game-time decision. Utah is missing Jusuf Nurkic, who is out with a foot injury, and Kyle Filipowski, who is day-to-day with a back injury and a game-time decision.
